userEnteredValue.stringValue: Master Set 3: D&D Battle for the Underdark

Blood Frenzy: When attacking with this Feral Troll, it receives 1 additional attack die for each Wound Marker on the defending figure's Army Card, for a maximum of 3 additional attack dice for Blood Frenzy.
Regenerate: After taking a turn with this Feral Troll, remove 1 Wound Marker from this Feral Troll's army card.

Parasite: For the entire game, if one of your Festering Honor Guard is on a Unique Hero's Army Card at the end of the round, you must roll the 20-sided die for that Hero. If you roll a 17 or higher, destroy that Hero. If a Festering Honor Guard is on a Unique Hero's Army Card when that Hero is destroyed by this Special Power, or by a normal attack, Special Attack, or leaving engagement attack, place that Festering Honor Guard on a space that Hero occupied, if possible.

Motherless Rage: If Queen Maladrix the Conqueror is in your Army, when she is destroyed, you may move any unrevealed Order Markers from her Army Card to this Army Card. Festering Honor Guards add 1 to their Attack Value if Queen Maladrix is in your Army and is destroyed.
Climb X2: When moving up or down levels of terrain, the Festering Honor Guard may double their height.

Black Powder Pistol: Start the game with 3 black Powder Markers on this card. After moving and before attacking, you may remove a Powder Marker from this card to add 4 to Bonny's Range Value for the rest of the turn. You may only use this Special Power once during a round.

Master of Disguise 13: The first time each turn that Fia Bonny is targeted by a Squad figure with a normal or special attack, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, Bonny cannot be targeted by that attack or any other attack this turn.
Disengage: Fia Bonny is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
Master Set 1: Rise of the Valkyrie
Attack Aura 1: All friendly figures adjacent to Finn with a range of 1 add 1 die to their normal attack.
Warrior's Attack Spirit 1: When Finn is destroyed, place this figure on any Unique Army Card. Finn's Spirit adds 1 to the normal attack number on that card.
Wave D1: Champions of Forgotten Realms
Lava Resistant: A Fire Elemental never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage, and it does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.

Searing Intensity: After moving and before attacking, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to at least one Fire Elemental you control. If you roll a 14 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Figures with the Lava Resistant special power are not affected by Searing Intensity.
Negative Element: A Fire Elemental can never roll defense dice while it is on a water space.

DRONE-DEPLOYED BOMBS: Start the game with 4 Remote Bomb Treasure Glyphs on this Army Card. At the start of each round, after placing Order Markers, you may place a Remote Bomb Treasure Glyph from this Army Card power-side up onto a space within 6 spaces of Firefly.

DETONATE SPECIAL ATTACK: Range Special. Attack 4. Choose 1 Remote Bomb Treasure Glyph on the battlefield. All figures within 1 space of the chosen Glyph are affected, regardless of engagement and line of sight. Roll once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Figures do not have height advantage against this attack. After this attack is resolved, remove the chosen Remote Bomb Treasure Glyph from the game.
DEFUSE 10: Firefly may add 10 to his 20-sided die rolls for Traps and to pick up Treasure Glyphs.
PHANTOM WALK: Firefly can move through all figures and never takes leaving engagement attacks.

GLIDE IN 11: Flint does not start the game on the battlefield. If Flint has not been placed on the battlefield, before revealing a numbered Order Marker, you may roll the 20-sided die. On 11 or higher, place Flint on an empty space not adjacent to other figures or on Glyphs. Then you may move any or all of your unrevealed Order Markers to this Army Card.

TACTICAL ACUMEN: When Flint or a G.I. JOE or Soldier figure you control within 3 clear sight spaces of Flint defends, it increases its Defense Value by 1 if Flint has height advantage on the attacking figure.

Fire When Ready: At the end of your Player Turn, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on this Army Card to take a turn with Frizzt Galagan. No other Army Card may take this turn instead of Frizzt. If Frizzt moves during this turn, he cannot attack.

RA-1A Guided Cannon Special Attack: Range 10. Attack 2.: RA-1A Guided Cannon Special Attack can target only figures that are adjacent to one or more figures you control. Figures never have height advantage against RA-1A Guided Cannon Special Attack.
Swim: Frizzt does not have to stop his movement when entering a water space.
Indomitable: If this Frost Giant of Morh begins its turn unengaged, add 2 to its Move value this turn. If it begins its turn engaged, add 2 to its Attack value this turn.
Battle Frenzy: After attacking with this Frost Giant of Morh, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may attack again with this Frost Giant of Morh.

Dying Swipe: If this Frost Giant of Morh is attacked with a normal attack by an opponent's figure and receives enough wounds to be destroyed, roll 3 attack dice. One at a time for each skull rolled, you may inflict 1 wound on any figure that is adjacent to this Frost Giant of Morh. Figures affected by Dying Swipe cannot roll any defense dice and can receive more than 1 wound each. After using Dying Swipe, remove this Frost Giant of Morh from the battlefield.
Run 3: Before Moving a Frostclaw Paladin, you may add 3 to that figure's Move value. If you do, subtract 2 from that figure's Attack value this turn.
Jandar Champion Bonding: Before taking a turn with the Frostclaw Paladins, you may take a turn with a Champion you control who follows Jandar.
Climb X3: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Fyorlag Spiders may triple their height.

Entangling Web: After moving and before attacking, you may choose any one small or medium opponent's figure that is engaged with at least three Fyorlag Spiders that you control. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, remove one unrevealed order marker at random from the chosen figure's Army Card (or cards if your opponent has more than one Common Army Card for that figure).
Predator Bonding: Before taking a turn with Fyorlag Spiders, you may first take a turn with any Predator you control. (Sujoah or any Wyvern)

Tidal Advance: At the start of each round, after placing Order Markers, you may move each Fierce and Unfathomable figure you control up to 1 space for each of your Order Markers on the Gelryie Vanguards.
Defend the Deep: A Gelryie Vanguard adds 2 to its Defense Value when it is on a water space or when it defends against an attack from a figure that has height advantage.
Swim: Gelryie Vanguards do not have to stop their movement when entering a water space.
Secrets of the Citadel: Clockwork Combine Research Expedition

Draconic Engineering: Gimbal starts each game with the B.R.E.A.T.H., W.I.N.G.S., and C.L.A.W.S. Treasure Glyphs on this Army Card. These Treasure Glyphs cannot be placed on this Army Card except by this power. Gimbal cannot drop these glyphs except when destroyed or with the Ablative Equipment Special Power.

Ablative Equipment: When Gimbal would take 1 or more wounds, you may place a B.R.E.A.T.H., W.I.N.G.S., or C.L.A.W.S. Treasure Glyph on this Army Card onto an empty space within 1 clear sight space of Gimbal. If you do, ignore all wounds.
Command Familiar: After revealing an Order Marker on Girushia, Grove Keeper, before taking Girushia's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.

Wicked Thorns: If an enemy Small or Medium figure moves adjacent to Girushia on a space where that figure could end its movement, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 10 or higher, the figure ends its movement and lowers its Attack Value by 1 until the end of the current turn. If you roll an 18 or higher, the figure also suffers one wound.

Reach: If an enemy figure is within 2 spaces of Girushia, and its level is no more than 9 levels above or 3 levels below Girushia's level, Girushia may add 1 to his Range Value when attacking that figure.
Gift of the Forest: At the end of a round, if Girushia is next to a tree or bush, you may remove one Wound Marker from this Army Card.

Cyberclaw: All small or medium opponent's figures that enter or occupy a space adjacent to any Gladiatron may not move. Figures affected by the Cyberclaw cannot be moved by any special power on an Army Card or Glyph.
Melee Defense 1: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, a Gladiatron adds 1 die.

Hanwi's Darkness: When you reveal an Order Marker, you may also reveal the "X" Order Marker on Glinerva the Kyrie Warrior to activate Hanwi's Darkness. Until you next reveal an Order Marker, Glinerva and all Small, Medium, and Large figures within 5 spaces of her cannot target or be targeted by non-adjacent figures with a normal or special attack.

Concealment 17: If Glinerva is targeted and receives one or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between the attacker and Glinerva. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 17 or higher, ignore any wounds Glinerva just received.

Flying: When counting spaces for Glinerva's movement, ignore elevations. Glinerva may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Glinerva starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
Secrets of the Citadel: Might of the New Alliance
Mighty Hero Bonding: Before taking a turn with the Gnarlfur Raiders, you may first take a turn with a Valiant or Relentless Hero you control whose Affiliation is Utgar or Jandar.
Brothers in Blood: Increase the Move, Attack, and Defense Values of this Army Card by 1 for each of your destroyed Gnarlfur Raiders.
Mob Attack: When attacking with a Goblin Cutter you control, if the defending figure is engaged with at least 2 other Goblin Cutters you control, it subtracts 2 from its defense dice.

Scurry: When a Goblin Cutter you control is destroyed by a normal attack from an opponent's figure, you may move 2 Goblin Cutters you control up to 4 spaces each, and all Goblin Cutters you control no longer have any visible Hit Zones for the duration of the attacking figure's turn while they remain unengaged. Goblin Cutters will never take any leaving engagement attacks when using Scurry.
Scale: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Goblin Cutters may add 2 to their height.
Tough: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, Gorillinators always add one automatic shield to whatever is rolled.
Rock Throw: If a Granite Guardian has a height advantage on an opponent's figure, it may add 2 to its range when attacking that figure.
Landslide: A Granite Guardian with a height advantage on an adjacent opponent's figure rolls an additional attack die when attacking that figure.
Gain High Ground: After taking a turn with Granite Guardians, you may move each Granite Guardian you control up to 1 space. This space may be up to 4 levels higher.

Guide of the Dead: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with a Grave Grim, you may move up to 6 Small, Medium, or Large Undead or Eisenek figures you control up to 3 spaces each.

Harrowing Presence: When an opponent rolls the 20-sided die for a Special Power on one of their Army Cards, if one or more of that Army Card's figures are within 3 spaces of a figure you control with the Harrowing Presence special power, they must subtract 3 from the roll.

Longshot Specialists: When a Greatbow Archer that has not moved this turn attacks a figure at Range 4 or greater, add 1 to her Attack Value. If the target figure is at Range 7 or greater, instead add 2 to her Attack Value.
Wave D1: Champions of Forgotten Realms

Ice Cold: While a Greater Ice Elemental is on a water or ice space, that space and all same-level water spaces adjacent to that Greater Ice Elemental are considered normal ice spaces. Figures do not have to stop their movement on normal ice spaces.

Ice Spikes 15: If an opponent's figure moves adjacent to this Greater Ice Elemental, roll the 20-sided die. If this Greater Ice Elemental is on at least one ice or snow space, add 2 to your die roll. If you roll a 15 or higher, the opponent's figure receives 1 wound. Figures can be affected by Ice Spikes only as they move into engagement with this Greater Ice Elemental.
Cold Healing: After taking a turn with this Greater Ice Elemental, if it is on at least one snow or ice space, remove 1 wound marker from this Greater Ice Elemental's Army Card.
Wave D1: Champions of Forgotten Realms

Loyalty To The Lizard King: At the start of the game, choose a unique Lizardfolk Hero you control, or a unique large or huge Dragon Hero you control, to be the Greenscale Warriors' Lizard King. A Greenscale Warrior rolls 1 additional attack and defense die when its chosen Lizard King is within 2 clear sight spaces. You can choose only one Lizard King for all the Greenscale Warriors you control. (It should be noted that there is no official Lizardfolk Hero in Heroscape.)
Lizard King Bonding: Before taking a turn with the Greenscale Warriors, you may first take a turn with their chosen Lizard King if it is still under your control.
Wherever There's Trouble: Before taking a turn with Greenshirts, you may move up to 2 unengaged G.I. Joe or Soldier Heroes you control up to 2 spaces.
Master Set 1: Rise of the Valkyrie

Chomp: Before attacking, choose one medium or small figure adjacent to Grimnak. If the chosen figure is a Squad figure, destroy it. If the chosen figure is a Hero figure, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, destroy the chosen Hero.
Orc Warrior Enhancement: All friendly Orc Warriors adjacent to Grimnak roll an additional attack die and an additional defense die.
Marro Warlord Bonding: Before taking a turn with Grok Riders, you may first take a turn with any Marro Warlord you control.
Mark of the Warlord: When attacking a figure that is adjacent to any Marro Warlord, Grok Riders add 2 to their attack dice.
Grok Training: Marro Hive cannot rebirth Grok Riders with its rebirth special power.
Double Attack: When Guilty McCreech attacks, he may attack one additional time.
Secrets of the Citadel: Crooked Crew of the Clockwork Combine
Double Attack: Once per turn, after attacking with Guilty McCreech, he may make 1 additional normal attack.
Deputize: At the start of the game, you may place a silver Badge Marker on 1 Unique Hero in your Army that is a Sniper or follows Einar or Volarak. For this game, it gains the Class of Lawman.

Long Arm of the Law: Once per turn, before, during, or after moving normally, you may choose a Treasure Glyph within 3 clear sight spaces and place that Glyph power-side up on Guilty's Army Card or the Army Card of a friendly Unique Lawman Hero within 3 clear sight spaces of Guilty. Do not roll for traps on Treasure Glyphs collected with Long Arm of the Law.
EXPEDITION LEADER: Gung-Ho and friendly figures within 2 clear sight spaces may choose to ignore any effects from terrain tiles they move onto or occupy other than molten lava.
COMBAT CHALLENGE: Figures engaged with Gung-Ho cannot make an attack unless that attack affects an engaged figure with the Combat Challenge special power.
NO FEAR, ALL FIGHT: Gung-Ho increases his Attack and Defense Values by 1 for each figure he is engaged with.
Evil Eye Defense: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure.

Tetsubo Special Attack: Range 1. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose one figure adjacent to the targeted figured to be attacked by the Tetsubo Special Attack as well. Roll attack dice once for both figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
DOUBLE DIABLO GUN: This figure can target non-adjacent figures even while engaged. Once per turn, after attacking with this figure, it may make one additional normal attack.

BATTLE READY: Before you reveal a numbered Order Marker on another Army Card in your Army, you may reveal the X Order Marker on H.I.S.S. Tank. If you do, move that numbered Order Marker to this Army Card and reveal it.
TANK MOVEMENT: When moving, this figure ignores elevation changes of only 1 level.
Command of the Wild: After revealing an Order Marker on Haluchott, Corruptor of Beasts, before taking Haluchott's turn, you may take a turn with up to two Small, Medium, or Large Beasts you control.
Staff of the Long Hand Special Attack: Range 6. Attack 2. You may use the Staff of the Long Hand Special Attack before or after using Haluchott's normal attack.
Calm the Beast: While defending against an attack from a Beast, Haluchott increases her Defense Value by 2.

Flying: When counting spaces for Haluchott's movement, ignore elevations. Haluchott may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Haluchott starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
Command Familiar: After revealing an Order Marker on Halushia, Scion of the Wild, before taking Halushia's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.
Rouse the Glade: Figures adjacent to a tree or bush roll one fewer Combat Die when defending against Halushia's attacks.

Ride-By Special Attack: Range 1. Attack 3. Instead of moving and attacking normally with Halushia, you may move him up to 4 spaces. Halushia can attack up to 3 times with Ride-By Special Attack at any point before, during, or after this move as long as he is on a space where he can end his movement. Halushia cannot attack the same figure more than once in a single turn with Ride-By Special Attack. When using Ride-By Special Attack, Halushia is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
Bleakewoode's Bane: Awakened Ancient of the Umbral Covenant

Toss 11: After moving normally with a Hand of Hrungnir, you may choose a Small or Medium figure adjacent to that Hand. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may place that figure on any empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of that Hand. A figure moved by Toss does not take any leaving engagement attacks.

Deathclap Special Attack: Line Special. Attack 5. If your Hands are in a straight line and there are no more than 6 spaces between them, instead of making a normal attack with each Hand, choose 1 Hand to use Deathclap Special Attack. All figures in a straight line between both Hands are affected by Deathclap Special Attack.

Heroic Defense Aura: When defending against a normal attack by an adjacent figure with any Samurai or Ashigaru figures you control within 8 clear sight spaces of Hatamoto Taro, you may roll Einar Valkyrie dice. Each Einar symbol rolled counts as an additional shield. Heroic Defense Aura does not affect Hatamoto Taro.
Adjacent Tough 1: When rolling defense dice for Hatamoto Taro, if Hatamoto Taro is adjacent to at least one figure who follows Einar that you control, add one automatic shield to the defense roll.
Bleakewoode's Bane: Awakened Ancient of the Umbral Covenant

United Body: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with Head of Hrungnir, you may first take a turn with 2 other different Relic Army Cards you control. Any figures activated by United Body must be within 7 spaces of Head of Hrungnir to be activated.

Giant Evil Eye: When Head of Hrungnir or a Relic figure you control within 7 spaces successfully defends against a normal attack from a figure that is within clear sight of Head of Hrungnir and is not adjacent to a Relic you control, the attacking figure takes 1 wound for each excess shield.
Bleakewoode's Bane: Awakened Ancient of the Umbral Covenant

Thunderous Heartbeat Special Attack: Range Special. Attack 2. Thunderous Heartbeat Special Attack affects all enemy figures within 7 spaces that are adjacent to Relics you control, regardless of line of sight. Roll attack dice once. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Figures never have height advantage against Thunderous Heartbeat Special Attack.

Bound by the Old Magic: When another Relic figure you control within 7 spaces would take 1 or more wounds, you may ignore those wounds. If you do, the Heart of Hrungnir takes an equal number of wounds.
Orc Champion Bonding: Before taking a turn with Heavy Gruts, you may first take a turn with any Orc Champion you control.
Disengage: Heavy Gruts are never attacked when leaving engagements.

Force Orb Special Attack: Range 5 Attack 3 Choose an opponent's figure to attack. Each opponent's figure adjacent to the chosen figure is also affected by Force Orb Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.

Mage Hand: After moving and before attacking with Heirloom, you may choose a Treasure Glyph on an unoccupied space within 4 spaces of Heirloom. You may move that Treasure Glyph onto an empty same-level space adjacent to Heirloom. Symbol-side-up Treasure Glyphs cannot be revealed, and power-side-up Treasure Glyphs must be placed power-side-up when moved by Heirloom.
Warforged Resolve: When rolling defense dice against a normal or special attack, Heirloom always adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

Blast Furnace 15: During Hellforge Mandukor's turn, before moving with it and each time it moves onto a space during this movement, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to the Hellforge. If you roll a 15 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Figures with the Lava Resistant Special Power are not affected by Blast Furnace. Hellforge cannot roll for Blast Furnace against the same figure more than once per turn.

Feed the Forge 15: If a figure or destructible object adjacent to Hellforge is destroyed, you may roll the 20-sided die. Add 8 to the roll if the figure is an Eisenek, Soulborg, or destructible object. If you roll a 15 or higher, you may remove a Wound Marker from this card.

Eisenek Advance: At the start of each round after all Order Markers have been placed, if all your ORder Markers are placed on Eisenek Army Cards, you may move Hellforge up to 4 spaces. Hellforge must end this movement on an empty space.

Expendable Rabble: If a Horned Skull Brute that you control is attacked with a normal attack against an opponent's figure and receives 1 or more wounds, you may destroy a small Goblin figure that you control that is adjacent to that Horned Skull Brute to ignore any wounds that Horned Skull Brute just received.

Barge Into Battle: After moving and before attacking, if a Horned Skull Brute you control ends its movement unengaged, you may choose an engaged small or medium friendly squad figure within 3 clear sight spaces of that Horned Skull Brute whose base is no more than 2 levels higher or lower than the base of the Horned Skull Brute. You may switch that Horned Skull Brute with the chosen squad figure. Figures moved by Barge Into Battle never take any leaving engagement attacks.

Ice Troll Charge: After moving and before attacking with this Ice Troll Berserker, roll the 20-sided die. If this Ice Troll Berserker is on a snow or ice space, add 3 to your die roll. If you roll a 13 or higher, you may move this Ice Troll Berserker again.
Cold Regenerate: After taking a turn with this Ice Troll Berserker, remove 1 wound marker from this Ice Troll Berserker's Army Card. If it is on a snow or ice space, remove 1 additional wound marker.

STOMP 8: Once during Imperator Kayne's turn, at any point during his normal movement that he is on a space where he could end his movement, you may choose an adjacent Small or Medium figure whose level is no more than 5 levels above Kayne's level and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 8 or higher, that figure receives one wound.
Rage Smash 5: When Incredible Hulk attacks using a normal attack, he receives one extra attack die for each Wound Marker he has, up to a maximum of 5 extra attack dice for Rage Smash.

Super Leap: Instead of his normal move, Incredible Hulk may Super Leap. Super Leap has a move of 10. When counting spaces for Hulk’s Super Leap movement, ignore elevations. Hulk may leap over water without stopping, leap over figures without becoming engaged, and leap over obstacles such as ruins. Hulk may not leap more than 50 levels up or down in a single leap. If Hulk is engaged when he starts to leap, he will take any leaving engagement attacks. Hulk rolls 3 less attack dice on any turn that he chooses to Super Leap.

Stomp Special Attack: Range 1. Attack 3. Any figure adjacent to Incredible Hulk is affected by the Stomp Special Attack. Roll 3 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense separately. Hulk cannot attack using his Stomp Special Attack on the same turn he uses Super Leap.
Iron Tough: When rolling defense dice against a Special Attack, this Iron Golem always adds 2 automatic shields to whatever is rolled.
Lava Resistant: This Iron Golem never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage, and it does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.

Dismissive Strider: Iron Lich Viscerot can move through small and medium figures, does not take leaving engagement attacks from small and medium figures, and can target and attack non-adjacent figures while only engaged with small and medium figures.

Vile Injection: Begin the game with 3 yellow Surge Markers on this Army Card. Once per turn, before moving with another Eisenek figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Viscerot, you may remove a Surge Marker from this card to add 2 to that figure's Move and Attack until the end of the turn.
Ironclad Puppeteer: After revealing an Order Marker on Viscerot and taking a turn with Viscerot, you may take a turn with another Unique Eisenek Hero or Squad you control.
Double Attack: When Iron Man attacks, he may attack one additional time.

Flying: When counting spaces for Iron Man's movement, ignore elevations. Iron Man may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Iron Man starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

Vanish 9: If Isamu is attacked and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die to vanish. If you roll 1-8, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 9 or higher, Isamu takes no damage and may immediately move up to 4 spaces. Isamu can vanish only if he ends his vanishing move not adjacent to any enemy figures.
Phantom Walk: Isamu can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
Dishonorable Attack: When attacking a figure who follows Jandar, Isamu rolls 2 additional attack dice.
ETERNAL SERVITUDE Isamu cannot be destroyed by wounds on this Army Card except during the end of round
PHANTOM WALK Isamu can move through all figures and never takes leaving engagement attacks.￼
Life Drain: Each time Iskra Esenwein destroys a figure, you may remove a wound marker from this Army Card. Iskra Esenwein cannot Life Drain Destructible Objects.

Summon the Rechets of Bogdan: After taking a turn with Iskra Esenwein, you may attempt to summon the Rechets of Bogdan if they are in your army and they have not yet been successfully summoned. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, you must place all 3 Rechets of Bogdan on empty spaces within 6 clear sight spaces of Iskra Esenwein. Any Rechets of Bogdan that you cannot place on the battlefield are immediately destroyed and cannot be summoned again. When the Rechets of Bogdan are summoned, you may immediately take a turn with them.

Flying: When counting spaces for Iskra Esenwein's movement, ignore elevations. Iskra Esenwein may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Iskra Esenwein starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
Master Set 1: Rise of the Valkyrie

Counter Strike: When rolling defense dice against a Normal Attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure. This power does not work on other Samurai.

Shotgun Blast Special Attack: Range 5. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figures are also affected by the Shotgun Blast Special Attack. James only needs a clear sight shot at the chosen figure. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. James cannot be affected by his own Shotgun Blast Special Attack.

Whip 12: After moving and before attacking, choose a small or medium figure adjacent to James. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 12 or higher, the chosen figure cannot roll any defense dice if attacked by James this turn.

Shield of Faith 13: If this figure would be affected by an attack, after attack dice are rolled, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, ignore all wounds figures you control would take from that attack. If you used Shield of Faith 13, this figure cannot roll defense dice against this attack.

Faithful Spirit: When Jeanne d'Arc is destroyed, you may place her figure onto a Unique Army Card. While she is on that Army Card, that Army Card gains the Shield of Faith 13 special power. If a figure from that Army Card rolls a 1–5 for Shield of Faith 13, remove Jeanne from that Army Card.

Reach: If an enemy figure is within 2 spaces of Jeanne, and its base is no more than 3 levels above Jeanne's height or 3 levels below Jeanne's base, you may add 1 to her Range Value when attacking that figure.
Learn From The Master: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with this Squad, you may first take a turn with a Ninja Hero you control.
Coordinated Takedown: While attacking, roll 1 additional attack die for each other friendly Ninja adjacent to the target.
Phantom Walk: Members of this Squad can move through all figures and never takes leaving engagement attacks.

Shotgun Blast Special Attack: Range 5. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Shotgun Blast Special Attack. Johnny only needs a clear sight shot at the chosen figure. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Johnny cannot be affected by his own Shotgun Blast Special Attack.

Rain of Flame Special Attack: Range 7 Attack 1+Special Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Rain of Flame Special Attack. Add 1 to Jorhdawn's attack dice for every additional Elf Wizard you control within 3 clear sight spaces of Jorhdawn, up to a maximum of +3 dice. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately. Jorhdawn cannot be affected by her own Rain of Flame Special Attack.

Wild Swing Special Attack: Range 1. Attack 4. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Wild Swing Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Jotun cannot be affected by his own Wild Swing Special Attack.

Throw 14: After moving and before attacking, choose one small or medium non-flying figure adjacent to Jotun. Roll the 20-sided die. if you roll a 14 or higher, you may throw the figure by placing it on any empty space within 4 spaces of Jotun. The figure must land within clear sight of Jotun. After the figure is placed, roll the 20-sided die for throwing damage. If you roll an 11 or higher, the thrown figure receives 2 wounds. If the figure is thrown onto a level higher than the height of Jotun or onto water, do not roll for throwing damage. The thrown figure does not take any leaving engagement attacks.
Quick Release Special Attack: Range 4 Attack 4 When Kaemon Awa attacks with his Quick Release Special Attack, he may attack one additional time.

Counter Strike: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure. This power does not work against other Samurai.
Valda's Vow: Fury of the Verdant Pact
SCAVENGER MOVEMENT COORDINATION: After taking a turn with Kaijaax, you may move up to 3 Scavenger figures you control up to 5 spaces each.
RADIOACTIVE: Non-Dracostacean figures within 2 spaces of Kaijaax reduce their Defense Value by 1.
INURED TO THE ELEMENTS: Kaijaax may choose to ignore any effects from terrain he moves onto or occupies.

Kato Katsuro's Command: Instead of taking a turn with Kato Katsuro, you may take a turn with one of the following that you control: • 1 Samurai Hero, or • 1 Samurai Squad, or • 1 Ashigaru Harquebu Squad and/or 1 Ashigaru Yari Squad. You may choose which Squad to activate first. Any figure in the above list that is taking a turn instead of Kato Katsuro must be within clear sight of Kato Katsuro before moving.

Mind Shackle 19: After moving and before attacking, you may choose any unique figure adjacent to Kee-Mo-Shi. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 19 or 20, take control of the chosen figure and that figure's Army Card. You now control that Army Card and all figures on it. Remove any Order Markers on the chosen figure's Army Card. If Kee-Mo-Shi is destroyed, you retain control of any previously Mind Shackled Army Cards.

Toxic Skin: After attacking, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to Kee-Mo-Shi. If you roll a 17 or higher, that figure receives one wound. Soulborgs are not affected by Toxic Skin.

Healing Touch: After moving and before attacking, choose a wounded hero figure adjacent to Kelda. Then roll the 20-sided die to add or remove wound markers from the chosen figure's card: -If you roll 1, add 2 markers. -If you roll 2-5, remove one marker. -If you roll 6-17, remove up to 2 markers. -If you roll 18-20, remove all markers.

Flying: When counting spaces for Kelda's movement, ignore elevations. Kelda may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Kelda starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
Secrets of the Citadel: Might of the New Alliance

Hive Tunnel: Instead of moving normally with Kha-Re-Ga, you may Hive Tunnel. Choose an empty space within 4 spaces that is no higher than 6 levels above or below her level, and place Kha-Re-Ga on that space. Then, roll the 20-sided die for each figure adjacent to Kha-Re-Ga. Add 1 for each Wound Marker on this Army Card. If you roll a 1–13, nothing happens. If you roll a 14–19, that figure receives 1 wound. If you roll a 20, that figure receives 3 wounds. If Kha-Re-Ga is engaged when she starts to Hive Tunnel, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
Relentless Assault: Each friendly figure adjacent to Khosumet with a relentless personality receives an additional attack die.
Unleashed Fury Enhancement: You may add 1 to your die roll when you roll for the Unleashed Fury power on any Army Card.

Witchcraft Telekinesis: After moving and before attacking, you may choose up to 2 different Small or Medium enemy figures within 5 clear sight spaces of Kilkorax the Kyrie Warrior. One at a time, roll the 20-sided die for each chosen figure. If the chosen figure is a Squad figure and you roll an 8 or higher, you may place the chosen figure onto a same-level space adjacent to Kilkorax. If the chosen figure is a Hero figure and you roll a 17 or higher, you may place the chosen figure onto a same-level space adjacent to Kilkorax. Figures moved by Witchcraft Telekinesis never take leaving engagement attacks.

Flying: When counting spaces for Kilkorax's movement, ignore elevations. Kilkorax may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Kilkorax starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

Blunderbuss Special Attack: Range 4. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Blunderbuss Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Killian Vane cannot be affected by his own Blunderbuss Special Attack.
Apparition: Figures must be within two spaces of Kita the Springrunner to target her with a normal or special attack.
Phantom Walk: Kita can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

The Captain's Way: At the start of the game, choose one Unique Captain you control to be the Knaves of the Silver Scimitar's Captain for this game. Knaves of the Silver Scimitar roll one additional defense die against attacks from non-adjacent figures when their chosen Captain is within 4 clear sight spaces.
Captain's Orders: Before taking a turn with the Knaves of the Silver Scimitar, you may first take a turn with their chosen Captain or a Pirate Hero you control.

First Assault 1: When attacking with a Knave of the Silver Scimitar, if the defending figure was not adjacent to that Knave of the Silver Scimitar at the start of this turn, that Knave of the Silver Scimitar receives 1 additional attack die.
Disengage: Knaves of the Silver Scimitar are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
Run 3: Before moving Knight Irene, you may add 3 to her Move value. If you do, subtract 2 from her Attack value this turn.

Overwhelm Special Attack: Range 1. Attack 3 + Special. You may attack twice with Overwhelm Special Attack. If you attack the same figure a second time, you may roll an additional attack die for the second attack. You may not use Overwhelm Special Attack if you used the Run Special Power this turn.
Crushing Blow: After moving and before attacking, you may inflict one wound on a Small or Medium Squad figure or a Small or Medium Common Hero adjacent to Knight Primus Adelbern.
Human Champion Bonding: Before taking a turn with the Knights of Weston, you may first take a turn with any Human Champion you control.
A Coward's Reward: Knights of Weston roll one additional die against figures leaving an engagement with them.

Charging Assault: Any or all Kozuke Samurai may add 3 to their Move number as long as they are unengaged prior to moving. Kozuke Samurai must be able to move adjacent to an opponent’s figure in order to use Charging Assault.

Counter Strike: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure. This power does not work against other Samurai.

Warp Space: Instead of moving normally, you may place a Krakenling on an empty space within 4 spaces. If a Krakenling is engaged when it starts to Warp Space, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
Eldritch Switch: After moving normally, a Krakenling may switch spaces with an adjacent single-spacefigure. Figures moved by Eldritch Switch never take any leaving engagement attacks.
Flailing Tentacles: A Krakenling may attack up to 3 times on its turn. Reduce the number of attacks by 1 for each Wound Marker it has.
Swim: A Krakenling does not have to stop its movement when entering a water space.

Into the Basket: Krampus starts the game with a Krampus' Basket Glyph on his Army Card. After moving and before attacking, you may choose an enemy Small or Medium figure adjacent to Krampus and roll the 20-sided die. If the figure is Common and you roll a 5 or higher, place that figure on your Krampus' Basket Glyph Card. If it is Unique and you roll a 15 or higher, place that figure on your Krampus' Basket Glyph Card.

Out of the Basket: After Krampus takes 1 or more wounds from an attack but is not destroyed, each player with 1 or more figures from their Army on your Krampus' Basket Glyph Card may roll a 20-sided die. If they roll a 13 or higher, they may place 1 figure from their Army that is on your Krampus' Basket Glyph Card onto an empty space within 1 of Krampus, or the nearest empty space.
Master Set 1: Rise of the Valkyrie
Stealth Dodge: When a Krav Maga Agent rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is not adjacent, one shield will block all damage.
Wounded Smash: When Krug attacks, he receives one extra attack die for each wound marker he has.
Double Attack: When Krug attacks, he may attack one additional time.

Ninjutsu Barrage Special Attack: Range 1 Attack 3 Instead of moving and attacking normally with Kumiko, you may move Kumiko up to 3 spaces. Kumiko can attack up to 3 times with Ninjutsu Barrage Special Attack at any point before, during, or after this move as long as Kumiko is on a space where she could end her movement. Kumiko cannot attack the same figure more than once on a single turn.
Phantom Walk: Kumiko can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

Summon Elemental: After moving and before attacking with Kurrok the Elementalist, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may, if possible, place one of your previously destroyed small or medium Elementals on an empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of Kurrok the Elementalist.

Master of the Elements: After revealing an Order Marker on Kurrok the Elementalist, instead of taking that turn with Kurrok, you may take a turn with up to three small or medium Elementals you control that are within 8 clear sight spaces of Kurrok the Elementalist.
Strength of Oak Aura 1: All friendly Elves adjacent to Kyntela Gwyn add 1 to their defense dice.
Motorized Zipline: Start the game with 3 Zipline Glyphs on this card. Before and after moving normally, you may place up to 1 Zipline Glyph on an empty space within 1 clear sight space of Lady Jaye.

Master of Disguise 14: The first time each turn that Lady Jaye is targeted for an attack by a Squad figure, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, Lady Jaye cannot be targeted by that attack or any other attacks this turn. ZIPLINE: TACTICAL MOVE (Permanent Glyph) Once per turn, when a Small or Medium figure ends its movement on a Zipline Glyph while moving normally, you may choose another Zipline Glyph within 6 spaces of that Zipline Glyph. Place that figure on a space within 1 of and on the same level as that Glyph. A figure that is engaged when it starts to zipline will take any leaving engagement attacks. Figures may move over a Zipline Glyph without stopping.

Vydar’s Range Enhancement Aura: All friendly figures with a range of 4 or more who follow Vydar and are within 4 clear sight spaces of Laglor add 2 spaces to their Range number. Vydar’s Range Enhancement Aura does not affect Laglor.

Autoload Special Attack: Range 7. Attack 3. When attacking with Autoload Special Attack, you may roll Vydar Valkyrie Dice. If you roll at least one Vydar symbol, you may attack again using Autoload Special Attack.

Brutality Aura: When a Squad figure you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Loviatäk the Kyrie Warrior attacks an adjacent figure with a normal attack, before defense dice are rolled, you may re-roll all attack dice that did not show skulls. Brutality Aura may only be used once per turn.
Deadly Strike: When attacking with Loviatäk, all skulls rolled count for one additional hit.
Dynastic Leadership: If you control Loviatäk and another Unique Kyrie Hero who follows Utgar, figures you control who follow Utgar increase their Move Value by 1.

Flying: When counting spaces for Loviatäk's movement, ignore elevations. Loviatäk may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Loviatäk starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

Concealment 12: If a Lurking Hive Soldier is targeted and would take 1 or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between the attacker and the Lurking Hive Soldier. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 12 or higher, ignore those wounds.
Disengage: A Lurking Hive Soldier is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

Highland Fury: At the start of the game, choose a Human Champion you control. While that champion is in play, MacDirk Warriors roll one additional attack die for each wound marker on the chosen hero. There can be only one Chosen Human Champion for all the MacDirk Warriors you control. MacDirk Warriors cannot attack their Chosen Human Champion.
Human Champion Bonding: Before taking a turn with the MacDirk Warriors, you may first take a turn with any Human Champion you control.
Valda's Vow: Fury of the Verdant Pact

SUNDERSTONE'S CHARGE SPECIAL ATTACK: Range Special. Attack 4. Instead of moving and attacking normally with Maeve Sunderstone, you may move her up to 3 spaces. Then move Maeve up to 5 spaces in a straight line, passing through all figures and taking no leaving engagement attacks. After moving, roll attack dice once for all figures passed through. Each figure rolls defense dice separately in the order moved through. Defending figures never have height advantage against this attack.

RUNEHAMMER OF MAEVE: After Maeve makes a normal attack against a single-space figure, if the defending figure is still adjacent, you may move that figure 1 space. Figures moved this way do not take leaving engagement attacks.

BLUDD'S BLASTER SPECIAL ATTACK: Range 5. Attack 0 + Special. Explosion 1. Add 2 automatic skulls to the attack roll. Major Bludd is not affected by his own Bludd's Blaster Special Attack. Bludd can use this attack only once per round.
Master Set 2: Swarm of the Morrow
Machine Pistol Special Attack: Range 7 Attack 2 Major Q10 may use this special attack 4 times in the same turn. Q10 may target the same figure or a different figure with each attack.
Wrist Rocket Special Attack: Range 4 Attack 4 Major Q10 may use this special attack 2 times in the same turn. Q10 may target the same figure or a different figure with each attack.

Full Barrage Special Attack: Range Special. Attack Special. When using Full Barrage Special Attack, Major Q11 may attack up to 3 times. Each attack must target a different figure and must use a different Range and Attack Value pair from the list below (in any order).: * Range 7, Attack 2. * Range 5, Attack 3. * Range 3, Attack 4. Major Q11 cannot target the same figure more than once per turn with Full Barrage Special Attack.

Vydar's Hammer: When Major Q11 attacks an adjacent figure with a normal attack, you may choose one Small, Medium or Large figure that is adjacent to the defending figure. If the defending figure receives any wounds from Major Q11's attack, the chosen figure receives one wound.

Queglix Gun Special Attack: Range 6. Attack 1, 2 or 3. Major Q9 starts each turn with 9 attack dice. Choose any figure within range and attack by rolling 1, 2 or 3 attack dice. Major Q9 may keep making special attacks with 1, 2 or 3 attack dice until he has rolled all 9 attack dice. Major Q9 may target the same or different figures with each attack.

Improved Cyberclaw: All small, medium or large opponent's figures that enter or occupy a space adjacent to Major X17 may not move. Figures affected by the Cyberclaw cannot be moved by any special power on an Army Card or Glyph.
Melee Defense 4: When rollling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, Major X17 adds 4 dice.
Command Familiar: After revealing an Order Marker on Marachott, Mind Whisperer, before taking Marachott's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.
Staff of Curupiran: When rolling attack dice for a normal attack, Marachott always adds 2 automatic skulls to whatever is rolled.

Marachott's Whisper: After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card and taking a turn with Marachott, you may choose a Unique Hero within 2 spaces of Marachott. Roll the 20-sided die, adding 3 to the roll if you control that Hero. If you roll a 16 or higher, take temporary control of that Hero and immediately take a turn with that Hero. After taking that turn, control of the chosen Hero returns to its previous owner. Any Order Markers that were on the chosen figure's Army Card stay on that card.
Life Drain: Each time Marcu Esenwein destroys a figure, you may remove a wound marker from this Army Card. Marcu Esenwein cannot Life Drain Destructible Objects.

Eternal Hatred: After revealing an order marker on this card, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, choose an opponent. That opponent will now control Marcu Esenwein for the remainder of your turn, but will not be able to view any unrevealed order markers on his card. At the end of that turn, control of Marcu returns to you. All order markers and figures that were on Marcu’s Army Card will stay on his Army Card.

Flying: When counting spaces for Marcu Esenwein's movement, ignore elevations. Marcu Esenwein may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Marcu Esenwein starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.
Soldier Leadership: All Soldiers you control move one additional space.
Soldier Attack Enhancement: All friendly Soldiers adjacent to Marcus Decimus Gallus receive an additional attack die.
MARIEDIAN TARGETING: When a Mariedian Resistance figure attacks, it adds 1 to its Attack Value for each other Mariedian that attacked the targeted figure this Player Turn.
GUERRILLA DEFENSE: When a Mariedian Resistance figure defends, it adds 1 to its Defense Value for each other time a friendly Soldier has defended this Player Turn.

Wild Pack Movement: Before moving, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-3, add 1 to the move value of this card. If you roll a 4-6, add 3 to the move value of this card. If you roll a 7-20, add 7 to the move value of this card.

Marro Plague: After moving and before attacking, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to any Marrden Hounds you control. If you roll a 16 or higher, that figure receives a wound. Soulborgs and Wulsinu are not affected by the Marro Plague.
Master Set 2: Swarm of the Morrow

Hivelord Life Bonding: Before taking a turn with Marrden Nagrubs, you may first take a turn with any Hivelord you control. Before moving the chosen Hivelord, you may destroy one adjacent Marrden Nagrub you control. If you destroy a Marrden Nagrub with Hivelord Life Bonding, remove 1 wound marker from the chosen Hivelord's Army Card.
Climb X2: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Marrden Nagrubs may double their Height.

Cell Divide: When a Marro Divider you control receives one or more wounds from a Normal or Special Attack by an opponent's figure, you may roll the 20-sided die before removing that figure. If you roll a 17 or higher, ignore any wounds that figure just received and, if possible, place one of your previously destroyed Marro Dividers on a same-level space adjacent to the defending Marro Divider.
Self Replicating: Marro Hive cannot rebirth Marro Dividers with its Marro Rebirth special power.

Hive Swarm: Before moving Marro Drones, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-12, you may move and attack with up to 3 Marro Drones you control. If you roll 13-16, you may move and attack with up to 6 Marro Drones you control. If you roll 17-20, you may move and attack with up to 9 Marro Drones you control.
Master Set 2: Swarm of the Morrow
Swamp Water Strength: When a Marro Drudge is on a swamp water space, add 1 to its attack and defense.

Swamp Water Tunnel: If a Marro Drudge ends its normal movement on a swamp water space, you may immediately place it on any empty same-level swamp water space within 5 spaces. If a Marro Drudge is engaged when it starts to tunnel, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
